_comment: Version-controlled IDENTITY of every registered discovery source (docs/28 A4). `discovery source sync` registers a missing entry DISABLED with ToS and robots UNKNOWN, and reports drift on an existing one; it never edits an existing row, never reviews, authorizes, enables or schedules, and never fetches. Approval, access basis, enablement and cadence live only in the database and are set by their own attributed commands. `decision` is a human-readable reference to the owner decision behind the registration, not an authorization.
